newsitem.title: USA: Geopgraphics stake raised by WisdomTree.
newsitem.headline: Geopgraphics stake raised by WisdomTree.

text.p: A group including WisdomTree Capital Management Inc said Friday it raised its stake in Geographics Inc to 8.9 percent or 839,500 common shares.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it bought 169,500 additional shares of the company between December 6 and 31 at prices ranging from $4.10 to $5.28 a share.
The group previously held a 7.1 percent stake or 670,000 shares in Geographics, a Blaine, Wash.,-based maker of design stationery, lettering, signage, stencil and graphic art products.
